name: Leo
description: Raised by parrots on Ginger Island until you befriend him. Duck feathers, mangoes, and patience matter most.

stardew.intro: A wild child on Ginger Island who joins Pelican Town after you earn his trust. Gentle, curious, and bird-loving.

heartEvents.summary: He introduces you to the birds who raised him.

heartEvents.summary: Linus offers him a tent — Leo considers joining the valley.

heartEvents.title: Town integration
heartEvents.summary: Vincent and Jas include him in play; he starts to belong.

heartEvents.title: Stargazing
heartEvents.summary: A quiet night together solidifies your bond.

relationships.name: Linus
relationships.note: Mentor figure who helps him adjust to town life.

relationships.name: Jas & Vincent
relationships.note: First friends his age once he leaves the island.

trivia: Unlock Ginger Island before trying to befriend him — he is not in Pelican Town at first.
